headline: Five Dollars, a Broken Foot and a Christmas Comeback

nflEvidence.finding: Foot fracture publicly reported before trade.
Shanahan reported an approximately eight-week estimate.
Potential Week 16 return after five missed contests.

article: Stilly bought a damaged Ferrari for the price of a waiver-wire pickup. The foot fracture was public before the exchange, and Kelce already occupied the starting tight end job. Stew received five FAAB for a player facing an extended absence. Kittle returned in Week 16 and started alongside Kelce, but the provider has no paired opponent for Stilly that week; his 11.20 points cannot be credited to a verified head-to-head playoff victory. Week 17 shows another starting appearance but its eligibility is unverified. The decision was a low-cost known-injury gamble, not a healthy-player acquisition derailed by an unexpected injury.
limitations: Week 14 and 15 paired scores confirmed; bracket classification requires canonical bracket reconciliation
Week 16 unpaired; not eligible as head-to-head impact
